Attack on Riyadh Airport Kills at Least 12, Injures Hundreds

An attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport on Saturday resulted in at least 12 deaths and hundreds of injuries. The projectile struck the passenger terminal complex housing domestic flight terminals 3 and 4. Operations at the airport were suspended following the incident. The Houthis claimed responsibility for the strike. India condemned the attack as "unacceptable" and called for an immediate cessation of attacks on civilians. A US citizen was confirmed among the fatalities. This incident is described as the deadliest attack in the Gulf since the Iran War.
